body:
HNeRV neural representation trained against the SegNet/PoseNet metric. Key ideas: pose-weight warmup (ramps PoseNet loss weight during training, took posenet_dist ~1.3 -> ~0.04) and a per-pair perturbation selector (~600-byte post-hoc distortion reducer, cut posenet_dist a further ~40%). 449k-param decoder, 6-bit weights / 4-bit embeddings + Brotli, 240KB archive. Self-contained under src/; CPU inflation ~1 min.

# submission name:
hnerv_pose_warmup_selector

# upload zipped `archive.zip`
<!-- do not check it in the code (it's already ignored in .gitignore) -->
<!-- you can use the upload file feature (drag and drop), make sure curl -L works -->
[archive.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/29012365/archive.zip)


# report.txt
```
=== Evaluation results over 600 samples ===
  Average PoseNet Distortion: 0.02539069
  Average SegNet Distortion: 0.01012791
  Submission file size: 240,272 bytes
  Original uncompressed size: 37,545,489 bytes
  Compression Rate: 0.00639949
  Final score: 100*segnet_dist + √(10*posenet_dist) + 25*rate = 1.68
```

# does your submission require gpu for evaluation (inflation)?
no — inflation is CPU-only and runs in ~1 minute (well under the 30-minute limit).

# did you include the compression script? and want it to be merged?
The decoder, codec, and selector are included under `src/` (needed for inflation). Full training
code is not bundled; the README describes the pipeline. Happy to add a standalone compress script
if useful.

# is this submission competitive or innovative? explain why
Innovative direction (not competitive with the #1 ~0.19 entries). It's an HNeRV neural
representation trained directly against the SegNet/PoseNet metric, with two ideas worth sharing:
(1) a **pose-weight warmup** that ramps the PoseNet loss weight up during training — this was the
single biggest lever, taking posenet_dist from ~1.3 to ~0.04, since a fixed small weight starves
pose at convergence; and (2) a **per-pair perturbation selector** (a post-hoc, ~600-byte
distortion reducer that picks one of 28 tiny transforms per frame pair to minimize that pair's
scored distortion), which cut posenet_dist a further ~40% for negligible rate.

# additional comments
449k-param decoder, internal resolution 648×810, decoder weights quantized to 6-bit + embeddings
to 4-bit + Brotli (240 KB archive incl. selector). Self-contained under `src/`; verified end-to-end
through `evaluate.sh` and in an isolated checkout (no repo-root deps). The score (1.68) beats the
classical-codec cluster but is well behind the HNeRV leaders — shared mainly for the warmup +
selector ideas. See `submissions/hnerv_pose_warmup_selector/README.md`.
